# Cloudflare Pages headers. Most specific match wins.
#
# GENERATED by build.js from src/headers.txt — the script hashes below are
# computed from src/theme.js and src/demo.js at build time. Edit the template,
# not the generated file.

# The distributable. People are meant to fetch these from other origins and
# from scripts, so they carry CORS — a <link> would not need it, but an agent
# reading the system with fetch() does.
/plain-text.css
  Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600
/plain-text-skins.css
  Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600
/plain-text-theme.js
  Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600
/system.md
  Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
  Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600
/llms.txt
  Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
  Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600

# Two version paths, two different promises.
#
# The exact version never changes, so it is immutable and cached for a year.
# The major line MOVES with each additive release inside v1, so it gets a day
# — calling a path immutable when it moves is the kind of small lie that costs
# somebody an afternoon of cache-busting.
/v1.0.0/*
  Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable
/v1/*
  Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400

/*
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
  X-Frame-Options: DENY
  Permissions-Policy: geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=(), interest-cohort=()
  # Two inline scripts: the theme bootstrap and the specimen's skin picker.
  # Both are admitted by hash rather than by 'unsafe-inline', so the policy
  # still refuses every other script on the page.
  Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src '{{THEME_HASH}}' '{{DEMO_HASH}}'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
